Also note: the Dockerfile's `RUN uv pip install --upgrade "anthropic>=1.0"` is an unpinned floating lower-bound (mirrors Dockerfile.spike as-is) -- it re-resolves to whatever the latest anthropic release is at build time, so two builds on the same base digest can still pick up different anthropic versions.
